title: For each department that has at least one subject with associated course ma
question: For each department that has at least one subject with associated course material, list the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, total number of such subjects per department, the subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, and the full department name, considering only degree-granting departments and subject codes. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.query_budget_protocol: 3 independently per Anchor/raw/full; maximum9, not sharedRQ4B3

access_trace.sql:
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_subject_codes,
  MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = LEFT(tso.SUBJECT_ID, LOCATE('.', tso.SUBJECT_ID) - 1)
WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE
LIMIT 20;
